body.name: Perspective Hall confidence polytope
body.construction: \(\widehat{\mathcal P}_{n,\alpha}=\{(\mathbf r,\mathbf s,\mathbf x):r_{bt}\ge0,\ \underline r_{bt}\le r_{bt}\le\overline r_{bt},\ \sum_{b,t}r_{bt}\le1,\ s_w\ge0,\ \sum_ws_w=\sum_{b,t}r_{bt},\ \underline q_w\sum_{b,t}r_{bt}\le s_w\le\overline q_w\sum_{b,t}r_{bt},\ x_{bw}\ge0,\ x_{bw}=0\text{ if }b+w>H,\ \sum_wx_{bw}=\sum_t r_{bt},\ \sum_bx_{bw}=s_w\}\).
